video.title: AI欧腐《被派去背叛我的Alpha/Sent To Betray My Alpha》
video.desc:
取名困难选择直译
After a car accident, 22-year-old Noel wakes up in a stranger’s bed—as a rare Omega. He slaps Kane, the powerful head of an elite family, and runs, only to discover that the world outside is far more dangerous than the man he left behind. All Noel wanted was a safe place to hide. Falling for the cold, commanding man who has a soft spot only for him was never part of the plan.
一场车祸后，22岁的 Noel 在陌生人的床上醒来——还成了一个罕见的 Omega。他一巴掌扇在 Kane 脸上，转身就跑。而这个人，是顶级豪门的掌权者。可 Noel 很快发现，外面的世界，比他逃离的那个男人危险得多。
Noel 想要的，不过是一个安全的藏身之处。爱上那个冷酷专横、却唯独对他心软的男人，从来不在计划之内。
